rationale: Adds --backend gpu (Skia Graphite on a Dawn device), --render-receipt and development-only --gpu-fault to the development-only pulp-design-ir-observe tool, plus its CLI test. The default Skia CPU render is byte-identical to before. The observer only reads an existing DesignIR and reports how it rendered; no importer, DesignIR schema, Chromium capture, production rendering, or packaging behavior changes, and no design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves. It supplies the Pulp-side observation for the Vellum parity harness GPU lanes under the 2026-10-04 temporary Pulp exception.
